decision: Should we hire this candidate as our first marketer, turn them down, or gather more evidence first?
limitations: Weights, must-haves, bars and the 3.0 hire line are your inputs or AAJ's defaults, not benchmarks. A badly written role profile produces a confident wrong call.
It scores only ratings with an evidence note but cannot judge whether a note is true or relevant; notes under four words are flagged as thin, nothing more.
It holds no salary or cost data. Any pay figure is the user's own, from public wage data for the location; the engine does not compare cost.
It does not check whether the company is ready to hire (retention in a segment, a working channel, founder time). A high score does not mean a hire will work.
review: The founder confirms the month 1 to 6 outcomes and must-haves before interviews, and puts split interviewers in one room with their notes before acting on the call. Counsel checks interview, pay-disclosure and reference rules.
